# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large bundle of short call snippets, and genuine **sales/enquiry/order calls form only a modest slice** of the total — most of the audio is internal/logistics chatter (Porter pickup coordination, vehicle location guidance, loading/unloading disputes, driver calls, payment follow-ups, HR/WhatsApp-hack confusion, fraudulent "Porter claim" scam calls). Within the sales-relevant calls, the company is clearly a **steel-roofing & structures dealer/fabricator**, not a construction contractor. Real customer-facing conversations consistently revolve around:

- Color-coated metal roofing sheets (GI/GP, AZ-150 coated) in various brands and thicknesses
- Polycarbonate sheeting (solid & multiwall)
- Roofing accessories (ridge, L-flash, crimp sheets)
- Welding electrodes/rods and self-drilling screws (as accessory/complementary items)
- Occasional pipe (MS/CHS) and purlin enquiries

Because genuine sales dialogue is diluted across many brief, repetitive stock/rate check calls, this KB keeps claims tightly grounded in what was actually said — no assumptions about "roofing projects," EPC work, or services beyond material supply are made.

## Products & brand ladder

**1. Color-coated roofing sheets (core product)** — supplied in JSW-sourced variants, positioned on a clear ladder:
- **"JSW" / Coloron Plus** — the flagship branded sheet, explicitly described as premium: *"Coloron Plus நல்ல branded sir. 15 years warranty வரைக்கும் வரும்"* [Coloron Plus is a good branded product — comes with up to 15-year warranty]
- **Silveron Plus** — positioned as "next grade" after Coloron Plus, same AZ150 base: *"Silver-on-க்கு அடுத்த grade-ங்கிற மாதிரி"* [Silveron is like the next grade]
- **Pragathi / Pragathi Plus** — a mid-tier line, frequently out of stock, often substituted
- **Radiance** — a lower-GSM competitor product used for price comparison (150 GSM, cited as competitor's cheaper alternative)
- **Asian Dhanush / Indra Dhanush** — the budget/"kammi quality kammi price" option: *"கம்மி quality and கம்மி thickness-ல வேணும்னு கேட்டீங்கன்னா 0.45 Asian இந்த Dhanush-னு ஒரு brand இருக்கு"* [If you want lower quality/thickness, there's a 0.45 Asian Dhanush brand]
- **Tata** — repeatedly requested by customers but *not stocked*: *"Tata brand available இல்லை Sir நம்மகிட்ட JSW தான் இப்போ இருக்கு"* [Tata not available, we only have JSW now]

Thickness range quoted: 0.40, 0.45, 0.47, 0.50, 0.60mm. Colors: Sky Blue, Half White/Off White, Grey, Green (Caliph Field Green), Royal Blue, Nova Blue — availability shifts call to call ("off போயிட்டு" = gone off/out of stock).

**2. Polycarbonate sheets** — solid vs multiwall distinction is a recurring technical education point for staff:
- **Solid** sheet = fully transparent (true see-through), available 4,5,6mm
- **Multiwall** sheet = twin/triple-wall, NOT truly see-through despite customer calling it "clear": *"multi wall clear-லாம் இங்க இருந்து அங்க பார்த்தா தெரியாது"* [multiwall "clear" sheet doesn't let you see through]
- Standard multiwall width 1220mm; full sheet size ~1220×2440mm

**3. Roofing accessories** — Ridge sheets (standard sizes, with/without lip), L-Flash (custom-cut, priced separately from sheet), Crimp sheets (cut to length, machine-dependent — can cause delivery delay)

**4. Welding consumables** — Tata Welding Rod/Electrodes sold via a separate outbound "Tata Welding Rod company" calling line; packaged in cartons of 8 or 12 packets

**5. Screws** — self-drilling screws (1 inch, 1.5 inch / 35mm, 40mm variants), sold in bulk box quantities (1000–2000+ numbers)

**6. Other occasional items**: MS pipe (CHS pipe enquiry declined — "MS pipe தான் இருக்கு"), cutting & grinding wheels, GI/GP plain sheet (bulk-quantity only, not retail-piece)

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

| Item | Rate quoted | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Coloron Plus 0.47mm sheet | ₹435 + GST / sq.meter | "Square meter rate" repeated across multiple calls as the standard pricing unit |
| Coloron Plus 0.50mm (plain) | ₹405–415 + GST / sq.meter | Price revised upward mid-conversation in several calls (₹410→₹415→₹430) |
| Coloron Plus (kg basis) | ₹111–114 / kg | Same product quoted in kg for bulk/trade buyers |
| Pragathi / Pragathi Plus | ₹380–385 / sq.meter; ₹102 / kg | Frequently "off" (out of stock), 2–3 day lead time to restock |
| Kalaram Plus | ₹425 / sq.meter; ₹102–113 / kg | Price moves day to day: *"இன்னைக்கு போட்டா மட்டும்தான் பழைய rate"* [only today's order gets old rate] |
| Indra Dhanush (Asian) | ₹91–98 / kg + tax | Cheapest tier; price volatile, rose from ₹90–92 to ₹96–98 within days |
| Polycarbonate Solid 5–6mm | ₹190 + GST / sq.ft (formula: 38×5) | "1 square feet + charge" |
| Polycarbonate Multiwall 6mm | ₹32 + GST / sq.ft | |
| Polycarbonate 2mm sheet | ₹800 + GST / sq.meter | Simple rate enquiry |
| Welding rod/electrode | ₹336/packet retail; ₹285+tax/packet bulk; ~₹332/packet for larger qty | Discount triggers at 10+ cartons |
| Tender/bulk institutional orders | Minimum Order Quantity: 5000 sq.meter | *"tender purpose-க்கும் rate மட்டும் சொல்ல முடியலாமா... minimum order quantity 5000 m² இருக்கணும்"* |

**Terms observed:**
- GST is **always added separately** (18%), never included in quoted rate unless stated
- Price revisions take effect same-day/next-day; staff repeatedly tell customers "இன்னைக்கு போட்டா பழைய rate" (order today to lock old rate)
- Credit terms: "1 week credit" mentioned; a customer complained payment still pending at 13 days
- Delivery/transport cost is usually **separate and customer's responsibility** for distant locations (Chengalpattu and beyond handled via Porter or courier, with ₹2,500–3,500 quoted)
- Accessories (L-Flash, ridge, crimp) are manually fabricated — **7–8 day lead time**, longer than standard sheet
- Plain GI/GP sheet sold only in **bulk quantity, not piece-meal**: *"G.I. G.P. sheet-லாம் கொஞ்சம் bulk quantity இருந்தா தான் சார் ready பண்ணி தருவாங்க. டெலிவரி பீஸ்க்காக பண்ண மாட்டாங்க."*

## Objection Playbook

**1. "Rate ஏறிடுச்சு" (Price just went up) — customer resists increase**
- Staff response: offer to honor old rate only if PO is placed immediately that day; otherwise politely hold firm — *"அதிகமா போனா ஒரு ₹5 கம்மி பண்ணுவேன், அதுக்கு மேல என்ன பண்றது?"* [If it's too much I can cut ₹5, beyond that what can be done?]
- When pushed hard on discount, staff frequently escalate to "sir"/management before committ
